$comment: Single source of truth for the CI/local build. Each release lists the Spriggit YAML folders to deserialize and where the built .esp lands inside the release (FOMOD) tree. 'dest' paths must match the source= attributes in that release's fomod/ModuleConfig.xml (verified by build/build.ps1 -CheckFomod). Paths are repo-relative, and every patch's sources live under src/<PatchName>/. Optional per-release keys: 'scripts' {from,to} bulk-copies committed .pex; 'allowUnreferencedPlugins' silences the warning about a plugin the FOMOD never installs; 'fomod': false ships a plain archive with no installer - the right shape whenever the install has nothing to ask (a single .esp with no options, e.g. a replacement plugin), and build/staging/<name>/fomod/ must then not exist. 'files' [{from,to}] copies committed loose files (a file or a whole folder) into the archive, where to='' means the ARCHIVE ROOT - that is how a SPID _DISTR.ini ships, since SPID scans the Data folder non-recursively and never sees a config in a subfolder; combine it with 'plugins': [] for a config-only release. Optional per-plugin key: 'scripts' [{from,to}] copies individual .pex. Add releases with the /mod-new-plugin skill. An empty 'releases' array is valid - the build reports 'nothing to build' and succeeds, so the repo stays green before the first patch exists.

releases.$comment: Script only - no plugin. Forks BOTH of SureAI's brawl scripts. ROOT CAUSE: an Enderal brawl is won by an AI PACKAGE on the opponent alias, DGForceGreetAfterBleedoutPackage 108B54, which requires GetStageDone(11A493,20)==0, IsBleedingOut==0, GetStage(11A493)>=15 AND GetStage(11A493)<100. The opponent bleeds out (stage 15), StopCombat runs, the engine stands her back up AT FULL HEALTH - that recovery is CORRECT AND REQUIRED - and the package then force-greets the player; that conversation is the win. But both scripts' OnMagicEffectApply answer an incoming magic effect with SetStage(150) - the alias script on any HOSTILE effect landed by the player, the player script on ANY effect at all from a non-player caster - and 150 is >=100, so the victory forcegreet is locked out permanently. Beside an animation-driven combat framework that trips on the first punch: For Honor Reforged's UNARMED move-set (and a brawl is unarmed by definition) casts LimbStrikes 0008AE via Payload Interpreter, carrying 'Poise Damage Non Blocking' 00089F and 'Stamina Damage' 00089E, both Hostile; its parry system casts 'Weapon Parry Poise Damage' 000892->0005F5 (Hostile) through the ReforgedParryController perk SPID gives every actor at 100%. Third person only because Behavior Data Injector registers For Honor's events on the shared 'Actors' behaviour project - the first-person graph has none. For Honor in Skyrim alone is fine: its unarmed hit casts SP_Impact_Fist 00082D->000823, NOT Hostile. FIX: gate both handlers on MagicEffect.GetAssociatedSkill() being one of the five schools - Enderal's own offensive effects all carry a MagicSkill, combat-framework markers carry none (verified: zero across For Honor in Skyrim + Reforged, 482 across base Enderal). DO NOT add SetStage(200) to OnEnterBleedout: 200 is also >=100, so it kills the same forcegreet and its fragment AllowBleedoutDialogue(False)s and Stop()s the quest - that was shipped once here and made the brawl unwinnable on its own. NO Property added/removed/renamed - the quest VMAD binds UnarmedWeapon, DGIntimidateFaction, Opponent and OpponentFriend by name. Fixes NQ12 (Silia Foxhand), NQ_G_04 (Duul), FS_NQ06 (Darius Kupferhammer) and the EnvironmentScene01 drunk. A brawl ALREADY at stage 150 needs 'setstage 11A493 15' once. Nothing else in the list ships either script loose, so no sort position is required. Credit: SureAI.
releases.name: Zenderal - Brawl Fixes

releases.$comment: ENDERAL 2.0 ONLY - ship with the old (2.0.12.4 / SSE 1.5.97) Zenderal release, never the 2.1 list. During the Ark siege (MQ12b 'Black Light' stages 5-125) Enderal 2.0's _00E_ChestAndDoorLockScript on the door bases says 'requires a key' on every scripted door outside the Sun Temple; SureAI keeps the story path open by placing Castle Quarters gate 09EECD with that script flagged InheritedAndRemoved. Ark City Gate Consistency Patch (Nexus 839, f1.01) rebuilds 09EECD on the 2.1 record (no scripts) and swaps its base to 11B116 (same script), so on 2.0 the gate the quest sends you through is locked. Override = the gate patch's 09EECD verbatim plus 2.0's VirtualMachineAdapter; WRLD 070729 + persistent cell headers forwarded from the gate patch, which it masters to load directly after. 096F6A (the other side) is left to Perpetuum Theater - Neo Enderal, which restores 2.0's record there. 2.1 exempts 09EECD by reference ID in _00E_ArkSiegeLockedGatesPerk 0493DB and has no such script. That record only helps a new game: a save keeps the lock script it already attached to 09EECD (CK wiki, Save File Notes). So hidden perk ZEN_ArkGateSiegeOpenPerk 0x800 (shape of SureAI's 2.1 siege perk 0493DB) replaces the player's activation of 09EECD during MQ12b 5-125 with Activate(player, true) - default processing only, which skips the baked script's OnActivate and its BlockActivation - and start-game-enabled quest ZEN_ArkGateSiegeQuest 0x801 adds the perk, also on the first load of an existing save. Generated by src/ArkGateSiegeFix/tools/01-build-ark-gate-siege-fix.py.

releases.$comment: No plugin - one SKSE DLL. An actor hit while flying as a ragdoll (Seismic Stomp under its SlowTime, but any knockdown) is sent GetUpBegin by the engine ~55 ms after the hit, turns animation-driven with no ragdoll or character controller, and hangs rigid mid-air (measured with ZenRagdollTrace). The plugin holds GetUpBegin until the actor's pelvis has settled (1 s within 4 units, wall clock; 8 s timeout) and refuses stagger*/recoil*/bleedOutStart events while an actor is ragdolled or knocked down (a stagger pulls the graph out of ragdoll and pins the body). Hooks Character::Update (vfunc 0xAD) and NotifyAnimationGraph (vtable 3, vfunc 0x01). Build with src/AirborneGetUpFix/build.cmd (shares the CommonLibSSE-NG clone in the repo-root lib/); compiled DLL committed because CI cannot build it.
releases.name: Zenderal - Airborne Get-Up Fix

releases.$comment: No plugin - one SKSE DLL. Dismembering Framework's player slow-mo resets time with SetGlobalTimeMultiplier(1.0), and its native only guards values below 1.0 against a running SlowTime effect, so a dismember cancelled Seismic Stomp's SlowTime. After data load the plugin re-registers DismemberingFramework.SetGlobalTimeMultiplier: while the player has a SlowTime-archetype effect DF may not change time at all; otherwise it behaves exactly like DF's native. Build with src/DFSlowTimeGuard/build.cmd; compiled DLL committed because CI cannot build it.
